scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:backend && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:frontend && youtrack-app app validate
scripts.build:nolint: npm run clean && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && youtrack-app app validate
scripts.pack: rm -rf issue-participants.zip && npx --yes bestzip issue-participants.zip dist/*
scripts.upload-local: set -a && source .env && set +a && youtrack-app app upload --host $YOUTRACK_HOST --token $YOUTRACK_TOKEN
scripts.update: npm run build && npm run upload-local
scripts.prepare:watch: npm run clean && rm -rf dist/widgets/assets && vite -c vite.config.backend.ts build --mode development
scripts.watch: npm run prepare:watch && rm -f .backend-changed .build-state.json && (AUTOUPLOAD=true npm run watch:backend & while [ ! -f src/api/api.d.ts ] || [ ! -f src/api/api.zod.ts ]; do sleep 0.5; done && AUTOUPLOAD=true npm run watch:frontend & npm run watch:coordinator)
scripts.dev: npm run prepare:watch && npm run dev:upload && rm -f .backend-changed .build-state.json && (npm run hmr & AUTOUPLOAD=true npm run watch:backend & while [ ! -f src/api/api.d.ts ] || [ ! -f src/api/api.zod.ts ]; do sleep 0.5; done && AUTOUPLOAD=true npm run watch:frontend:hmr & npm run watch:coordinator)
scripts.dev:build: npm run clean && npm run build:backend && DEV_MODE=true npm run build:frontend
scripts.dev:upload: npm run dev:build && npm run upload-local
